authorization: Owner explicitly requested Santi Wong modular rebuild after inspecting Captain Livé references on 2026-10-11; supersedes old Livé-only art scope for Santi source creation. Does not imply Livé full engine fit is verified.

slot_ownership.head: Bald head and neck, lips slightly parted
slot_ownership.waist: Leather harness, belt and empty tool loops

pose_contract.body: A-pose, arms about45 degrees down, palms down; scaffold head retained
pose_contract.other_wearables: Fit same Santi body in T-pose; no independent arm pose applies

fit_contract.instruction: Retain assembled Santi1.70m silhouette including tall hat. Uniformly fit each piece to Santi body in T-pose after reconstruction. Do not normalize every component to1.70m, copy Livé fits or stretch image axes. Bare-body1.40m is provisional, not measured mesh.

rigging_contract.route: Follow docs/RIGGING.md: one donor Mixamo armature; do not auto-rig every piece. Fitcheck real Santi body first; his short limbs and belly make donor alignment unverified.
rigging_contract.scaffold_head: Retain in source; hide/remove base head surface under detailed head.
rigging_contract.jaw: On detailed head skeleton; upper teeth fixed, lower teeth/jaw linked, tongue weights verified with re-imported mesh; test closure without tearing.
rigging_contract.face_goatee: Goatee follows Jaw; moustache follows Head.
rigging_contract.coat_mapping: Existing coat slot used for cloth apron; no slot addition required.

status: Eleven source sheets and sidecars delivered. Four-view extraction verified per piece; native source height/projection differences recorded. Reconstruction, fit and animation untested.
inspection: Approved Santi source/turnaround and matching Livé modular sheet visually inspected before each generation; source reference hashes recorded in sidecars.
